Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images show a multicystic mass in the fetal right hemithorax (indicated by arrows) with Doppler confirming a systemic feeding vessel, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM. Such lesions typically arise in the lower/middle lobes and can cause mass effect, displacing the heart to the contralateral side and elevating the ipsilateral diaphragm, which aligns with option B's description of the spatial relationships and secondary effects.
